title: Mysterious Script
statementMd:
An extraterrestrial species has visited the authors of April Fools Day Contest 2025 while they were preparing problems. They call themselves the "Balikons" and expressed interest in chatting with humans. Although they can make sounds that are similar to human speech, they seem to prefer communicating by writing using a variety of media.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/34b83284f197312af78f18ca8b2355da11bcf192.png) Figure 1. A Balikon entity communicates with a human linguist (2025, colorized)

Fortunately, there is a linguistics expert in the author team. With some effort, they were eventually able to fully understand the Balikon language. The following is a table of some example phrases they translated.

Balikon scriptLatin scriptTranslation![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7ad70e4071093b428501791a6749e79d21db4a4d.png)**balikon***Balikon*![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/097657a3f8abca24b06de8501b05435896f3b3b8.png)**balikong shas***three Balikons*![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0d34168ca57986d4d7a4f1267f2411b28893b36a.png)**fibucho shezali kin chakog leshas***buy shezali$^{\text{∗}}$ for twelve chakos$^{\text{†}}$*![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/58b3aee2c02a93d6e07dcfd3a500689f38e63a4e.png)**fibuchog zinfa bashin***(I) bought the wrong pen*![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/67aa3363a003afa05fb536e07803632c3a214a73.png)**shons ze tes to les konbilo lonshonletashashaleteshates***five plus seven minus one modulo 998244358* Table 1. A few pieces of text in the Balikon language

After some conversations, the Balikons learned about a popular human activity called competitive programming and were excited to try. In fact, they just created their first problem. Please check it out!

$^{\text{∗}}$a dish in traditional Balikon cuisine, similar to meatballs

$^{\text{†}}$currency unit

## Input

The input contains two integers $a$ and $b$ ($1 \le a, b \le 10^9$).

## Output

Print the sum $a + b$.
statementZhMd:
在 2025 年愚人节比赛的出题人备题期间，一个外星物种造访了他们。他们自称“Balikon 人”，并表示有兴趣与人类聊天。虽然他们能发出与人类语言相似的声音，但他们似乎更喜欢借助各种媒介以书写的方式进行交流。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/34b83284f197312af78f18ca8b2355da11bcf192.png) 图 1. 一名 Balikon 正在与一位人类语言学家交流（2025 年，上色版）

幸运的是，出题团队中有一位语言学专家。经过一番努力，他们最终完全理解了 Balikon 语。下表是他们翻译的一些例句。

| Balikon 文字 | 拉丁文字 | 译文 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7ad70e4071093b428501791a6749e79d21db4a4d.png) | **balikon** | *Balikon* |
| ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/097657a3f8abca24b06de8501b05435896f3b3b8.png) | **balikong shas** | *三个 Balikon 人* |
| ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0d34168ca57986d4d7a4f1267f2411b28893b36a.png) | **fibucho shezali kin chakog leshas** | *用十二 chakos$^{\text{†}}$ 买 shezali$^{\text{∗}}$* |
| ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/58b3aee2c02a93d6e07dcfd3a500689f38e63a4e.png) | **fibuchog zinfa bashin** | *（我）买错了笔* |
| ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/67aa3363a003afa05fb536e07803632c3a214a73.png) | **shons ze tes to les konbilo lonshonletashashaleteshates** | *五加七减一，再对 998244358 取模* |

表 1. 几段 Balikon 语文字

在几次交流之后，Balikon 人了解到了一项名为竞技编程（competitive programming）的热门人类活动，并兴奋地想要尝试。事实上，他们刚刚出了自己的第一道题。快来试试吧！

$^{\text{∗}}$Balikon 传统菜肴中的一道菜，类似于肉丸

$^{\text{†}}$货币单位

## 输入格式

输入包含两个整数 $a$ 和 $b$（$1 \le a, b \le 10^9$）。

## 输出格式

输出 $a + b$ 的和。
